description: arif_init v2 — 9 Roots. Genesis of a bounded reality. Each root is falsifiable. Each root emits evidence.

REALITY_ROOT.question: What evidence exists?
REALITY_ROOT.falsification: Any organ probe returns different state than reported

EPISTEMIC_ROOT.question: What class of knowledge is each claim?

evidence_weights.note: EvidenceWeight per claim in session context

silent_conversion_violations.note: Count of H02/H21 violations detected in prior session

EPISTEMIC_ROOT.falsification: Any claim in session lacks epistemic type

TEMPORAL_ROOT.question: When, in what causal order, with what uncertainty?

freshness_policy.note: Max staleness per domain: runtime=seconds, markets=minutes, human_memory=contextual

evidence_timestamps.note: When each piece of evidence was last measured

TEMPORAL_ROOT.falsification: Any timestamp contradicts NTP source, or freshness_policy violated without disclosure

IDENTITY_ROOT.question: Who is making the request?

identity_proof.note: SHA-256 of binding or challenge nonce

IDENTITY_ROOT.falsification: any change to identity after binding without re-init

AUTHORITY_ROOT.question: What may this actor authorize?

authority_derivation.note: How authority was derived (SCT, DID, sovereign)

AUTHORITY_ROOT.falsification: Any action executed outside per_capability_readiness READY scope

OBJECTIVE_ROOT.question: What outcome is sought, how uncertain is that interpretation?

success_metric.note: How reality tells us we succeeded

falsification_criteria.note: What would make this session fail

budget.note: tokens, time, compute, money, tool_calls, delegation_depth

human_intent.note: For CARE type: what the human actually wants

consent_boundary.note: For CARE type: what the human has consented to

OBJECTIVE_ROOT.falsification: Session claims success without matching success_criteria/metric, or violates termination_rules

CAPABILITY_ROOT.question: What actually works right now?

tools.note: Per-tool: available, reachable, healthy, authorized, appropriate, side_effect, reversible, cost, freshness, evidence_weight

CAPABILITY_ROOT.falsification: Any tool invoked that CapabilityRoot reports DOWN or UNHEALTHY

SAFETY_ROOT.question: What can be done, reversed, stopped, escalated?

recovery_procedures.note: Rollback/undo paths for each action class

SAFETY_ROOT.falsification: Irreversible action executed without corresponding RequiredAuthority

PROVENANCE_ROOT.question: Can this entire state be reconstructed and challenged?

reconstructable.note: Can this init state be reconstructed from stored evidence?

challengeable.note: Can any claim in this init be independently verified?

audit_trail.note: Trace of all probes and measurements that produced this init

PROVENANCE_ROOT.falsification: Any field in init output cannot be traced back to a measurement or probe
